citation_result.description: Verdict for one citation. correct_pdf_page_number1 / correct_viewer_page1 are lists because a quote may span several physical pages (cross-page citations); each entry is 1-based and equals the corresponding pdf_page_index0 + 1. They are null when no correct page can be stated (UNLOCATABLE / UNKNOWN / AMBIGUOUS without a candidate set).

candidate_source_pages0.description: All physical pages (0-based) where the normalised quote was actually found. Empty when the quote is not locatable in the extractable text.

citation_page_basis.description: Basis of citation_page_value, copied from the bundle display record (never re-inferred).

citation_page_value.description: Raw page value as cited, verbatim (integer / string / null).

correct_pdf_page_number1.description: Correct 1-based physical page number(s) for the true source page(s), or null when no correct page can be stated.

correct_viewer_page1.description: Correct viewer target(s), 1-based, always equal to correct_pdf_page_number1 when both are present; null exactly when correct_pdf_page_number1 is null.

evidence.description: Stage-diff evidence, earliest first: the upstream value, the downstream value, and where they first diverge, plus missing fields.

expected_source_pages0.description: Physical pages (0-based) the trace says the quote should come from (the authoritative source set), or null when the trace gives no usable source set.

fault_type.description: Fault class, or null when verdict is PASS or an uncertainty verdict with no fault class. Values per PROJECT_BOOK §5.

first_fault_stage.description: First stage (Extraction -> Chunking -> Indexing -> Display) where the value provably diverges, or null when no stage can be blamed (PASS, or trace missing).

notes.description: Human-readable notes, e.g. why a page could not be stated. Must not contain document body text beyond a short quote snippet, and only when the user enabled snippets.

observed_page_value.description: Page value the display layer actually showed / handed to the viewer, verbatim (integer / string / null).

quote_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalised quote text (PROJECT_BOOK §4.2 normalisation). The raw quote text is not stored in the report by default.

verdict.description: Outcome for this citation. FAIL_* are the four PROJECT_BOOK §5 fault verdicts. UNKNOWN_TRACE_MISSING: a stage snapshot is missing so no stage may be blamed. UNKNOWN_PAGE_BASIS: the cited basis is UNKNOWN so no viewer page may be computed. AMBIGUOUS: the quote occurs on several pages with no reliable anchor. NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW: exact match failed and the tool refuses to guess.

downstream_value.description: Value at the later stage (integer / string / null / array of integers or strings).

field.description: Field whose value diverged or went missing, e.g. 'source_page_indices0', 'viewer_page1', 'citation_page_basis'. Always a named field, never a bare 'page'.

note.description: What diverged, in words (e.g. 'display passed 0-based 6 to a 1-based viewer; correct viewer_page1 is 7').

stage.description: Stage where this evidence was observed.

upstream_value.description: Value at the earlier stage (integer / string / null / array of integers or strings).

page_index0.description: Physical PDF page index, 0-based, in [0, page_count-1].

page_number1.description: Human 1-based physical page number, strictly pdf_page_index0 + 1.

description: PageTrace analysis report (P026, PROJECT_BOOK.md v1.0.0 §6.4). Frozen by T001. A bare field named 'page' is forbidden anywhere: every object sets additionalProperties:false and 'page' is not a listed property. Machine execution time, absolute local paths and temporary directory names must NOT be part of the normalised result hash (PROJECT_BOOK §6.4); generated_at, when present, is excluded from that hash. Runtime rules the schema cannot express (verdict PASS implies fault_type and first_fault_stage are null; correct_viewer_page1 equals correct_pdf_page_number1 when present) live in docs/PAGE_SEMANTICS.md.

page_count.description: Number of physical PDF pages. Maximum 500 is the PROJECT_BOOK §13 default refusal threshold.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact PDF bytes analysed.

generated_at.description: Optional report generation time (RFC 3339). Excluded from the normalised result hash; never used as evidence.

results.description: One entry per citation, in bundle citation order.

summary.description: Counts are derived from results; normalised_result_sha256 is the hash of the normalised report (no timestamps, paths or temp names) used by the S0 100-replay gate (PROJECT_BOOK §8.4).

normalized_result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalised report, or null when the run produced no normalisable result.

total_citations.description: Number of citations analysed; equals len(results).

version.description: PageTrace tool version that produced the report (semver, e.g. '0.1.0').

title: pagetrace.report/v1
